value.rationale: The result extends a benchmark exact upper-geodetic computation from two to three partite classes, where the feasibility problem changes qualitatively to a three-class capacitated Hall system. It supplies an infinite stable exact value, a complete equality-set structure, and an exact count rather than a routine substitution or isolated small-order computation.
